name: QuickBooks
description: Read vendor bills, vendors, and invoices from the authenticated user's QuickBooks Online company (accounts payable).
_authNote: OAuth endpoints, scopes, client secret ref and the realmId capture-from-callback are PLATFORM-OWNED — they live in the private clarity-api (integrations-v2/config/oauth-configs.ts + integration-http-specs.ts), never in this public repo. This manifest only declares that the integration uses oauth2 and which tools it provides.

providedTools.description: List vendor bills (accounts payable) for the connected company.
List vendors for the connected company.
Fetch a single vendor bill by id.
List vendor credits (AP credit memos) — the confirmation a vendor actually credited back an overbilling.

_localNote: Studio CANNOT broker this yet: no connector in packages/connectors. Calling any of these tools from an automation will fail at run time. See .claude/skills/add-an-integration/SKILL.md to request one.
